name: medallion-burst-lock
title: Medallion burst and lock
summary: A medallion of 336 cut-paper inlay pieces bursts into five spiral arms around a white-gold sun, unwinds home and locks piece by piece, lighting from behind as it locks.

name: parallax-sheets
title: Parallax sheets
summary: Six cut-paper sheets at depths 0.12 to 1.35 slide past each other on one slow push-in; a walker on the subject sheet steps at 15 poses a second.

name: stop-motion-clock
title: Stop-motion clock
summary: A paper bird crouches, hops onto a cup and lands with a squash, then cut-paper letters drop in one by one: poses step 15 times a second while the camera pushes every frame.

name: wet-floor-reflection
title: Wet floor reflection
summary: A paper lightbox at night split down one axis, neon on the left and warm arches on the right, two faceless figures back to back, all mirrored in a wet floor that sways.
